zh.title: 11艘共艦、17架次共機擾台 國軍嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部11月22日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自11月21日上午6時至11月22日上午6時，偵獲11艘共艦、1艘公務船及24架次共機，其中17架次逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾中部及西南空域；國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處，另偵獲2顆中共空飄氣球逾越中線。
body: 國防部11月22日上午公布共機艦動態，統計自11月21日上午6時至11月22日上午6時，偵獲11艘共艦、1艘公務船及24架次共機，其中17架次共機逾越台灣海峽中線，侵擾中部及西南空域。國防部表示，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
國防部同時公布2顆中共空飄氣球動態。第1顆於11月21日上午9時55分逾越台海中線，位置在基隆以西47浬、高度1萬2000呎，於上午11時25分消失；第2顆於上午11時40分逾越台海中線，位置在台中西北54浬、高度3萬呎，於下午1時25分消失。

en.title: Taiwan detects 11 PLA warships and 24 PLA aircraft, 17 crossing the median line
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said that between 06:00 on November 21 and 06:00 on November 22 it detected 11 PLA warships, one official vessel and 24 PLA aircraft sorties, 17 of which crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait into the central and southwestern airspace; the military monitored the activity closely, and also tracked two PLA balloons crossing the median line.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said on the morning of November 22 that, between 06:00 on November 21 and 06:00 on November 22, it detected 11 People's Liberation Army (PLA) warships, one official vessel and 24 PLA aircraft sorties around Taiwan, 17 of which crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait into the central and southwestern airspace. The ministry said the armed forces monitored the activity closely with mission aircraft and vessels and land-based missile systems.

The ministry also reported two PLA balloons. The first crossed the median line at 09:55 on November 21, 47 nautical miles west of Keelung at an altitude of 12,000 feet, and disappeared at 11:25; the second crossed at 11:40, 54 nautical miles northwest of Taichung at 30,000 feet, and disappeared at 13:25.

facts.claim: Between 06:00 on November 21 and 06:00 on November 22, Taiwan detected 11 PLA warships, one official vessel and 24 PLA aircraft sorties, 17 of which crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait into the central and southwestern airspace.
Taiwan's military monitored the PLA activity closely with mission aircraft and vessels and land-based missile systems.

Two PLA balloons crossed the median line: the first at 09:55 on November 21, 47 nautical miles west of Keelung at 12,000 feet, disappearing at 11:25; the second at 11:40, 54 nautical miles northwest of Taichung at 30,000 feet, disappearing at 13:25.
